Hip is elevation from the downward torso axis (the thigh pitch). Knee is 0 when straight. Spine is the torso angle from world vertical, matched to trunk_lean_from_cam_vertical. Pelvis is hip height above the contact (ramp normal on the slide, hip above the lower sole otherwise) versus root_height_above_feet scaled by 0.90/0.75.
